author: Home Repair Tutor
description: Fiberglass shower removal is no fun. But it can be cathartic. I remove drywall first then cut shower walls into 3 foot sections. I like using an oscillating multitool with a carbide blade for most of the demo. I also recommend wearing gloves because fiberglass is sharp. The Ironclad Command Impact HI-VIZ gloves are fantastic - use coupon code HOME10 to get a discount at ironclad.com 👍🏼
